name: switchboard
description: One local screen for everything your AI assistants are waiting on you for, with the draft attached.
long_description: Switchboard runs on this computer and shows everything your assistants need from you: drafts to approve, choices to make, jobs that broke. Claude puts each one on the board with the draft attached; you approve, edit or decline on the board, and Claude picks up exactly what you decided. Only the board page can approve: Claude cannot approve on your behalf. Say "open my Switchboard" to see it. The board and its data stay on this computer.

tools.name: raise_light
tools.description: Put one thing on your Switchboard, with the draft attached.

tools.name: update_light
tools.description: Move a light along as its thread progresses, or mark it done.

tools.name: close_light
tools.description: Close a light when the work it stood for is finished or no longer needed.

tools.name: search_history
tools.description: Search what you already decided, so nothing is asked twice.

tools.name: list_lights
tools.description: See what is on the board now.

tools.name: get_decisions
tools.description: Collect what you decided on the board.

tools.name: wait_for_decision
tools.description: Wait up to 50 seconds for your answer on one light.

tools.name: complete_decision
tools.description: Report what happened after acting on your decision.

tools.name: ack_decisions
tools.description: Report several handled answers at once (not messages).

tools.name: add_area
tools.description: Create or update a container: a business, a project, school, family.

tools.name: open_board
tools.description: Open your board in your browser. The link is never shown to Claude.

tools.name: setup_guide
tools.description: The first-run questions and steps for setting up your board.

port.title: Port
port.description: Where the board listens on this computer. Leave it at 4747 unless another program uses that port.

data_folder.title: Data folder
data_folder.description: Where the board keeps its data. Leave it as it is unless you already keep Switchboard data somewhere else.
